requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Reduce the number of product reference names shown to customers during the Out-Of-Box Experience (OOBE) at 123.hp.com for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series to a single, consistent name.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must reliably operate and meet intervention specifications for all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media under various climatic conditions for the Manhattan platform.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must function correctly and without hardware failure when placed and operated on uneven surfaces such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Assess printer functionality for failures when the device is tilted 20 degrees left and right during printing.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: The printer must maintain print quality and function correctly when printing while placed on a trolley.
